milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the polished granite structure (centered at ~11.5,1,11.5) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining green concrete powder causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with NO green concrete powder (only a wooden pickaxe), so having ≥1 in inventory definitively proves they mined it from the scene. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.
